name: Org Browser Full Roster - Weekly Monday 4AM Arizona

parameters.sqlQuery:
-- Full Customer Service org roster: every active employee (agents) plus the
-- complete management chain and org attributes on each row.
--
-- Source table is EMPLOYEE/DAY level (not manager level), so no join is needed.
-- Verified column list: emid, employee, mgremid, manager, mgr2emid, manager2,
-- srmgremid, srmanager, name, username, stillatwayfair, siteid, site,
-- virtualflag, team, styid, subentity, regionid, region, typeofsite, wgid,
-- workgroup, parentwgid, parentworkgroup, grandparentwgid,
-- grandparentparentworkgroup, lastrundate, currentskilllevel, overallranking,
-- topxpercent, skillranking, majorityskill, skill_1_start_date,
-- skill_2_start_date, skill_3_start_date, hierarchylevel, emailaddress,
-- mgremailaddress, TimePeriod, date, datetype, swapid, hiredate, daystenured,
-- plus a long tail of *_to_goal performance metrics (excluded here on purpose --
-- this is a directory, not a scorecard). To include them too, add them to the
-- SELECT list; the downstream Code nodes build headers dynamically from whatever
-- columns this query returns, so no other node needs to change.

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS snapshot_date
  FROM `wf-gcp-us-ae-cs-prod.cs_reporting.tbl_customer_service_employee_performance_manager`
  WHERE datetype = 'Day'
    AND date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('America/Phoenix'), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
                 AND CURRENT_DATE('America/Phoenix')
)
SELECT
  -- Employee / agent identity
  CAST(t.emid AS STRING) AS `Employee ID`,
  TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(t.employee, '')), r'^([^,]+),\s*(.+)$', r'\2 \1')) AS `Employee Name`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.name, '')) AS `Employee Name Raw`,
  LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(t.username, ''))) AS `Username`,
  LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(t.emailaddress, ''))) AS `Employee Email`,
  IF(t.stillatwayfair, 'Yes', 'No') AS `Active`,
  CAST(t.hierarchylevel AS STRING) AS `Hierarchy Level`,
  CAST(SAFE_CAST(t.hiredate AS DATE) AS STRING) AS `Hire Date`,
  CAST(t.daystenured AS STRING) AS `Days Tenured`,

  -- Management chain
  CAST(t.mgremid AS STRING) AS `Manager ID`,
  TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(t.manager, '')), r'^([^,]+),\s*(.+)$', r'\2 \1')) AS `Manager Name`,
  LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(t.mgremailaddress, ''))) AS `Manager Email`,
  CAST(t.mgr2emid AS STRING) AS `Manager 2 ID`,
  TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(t.manager2, '')), r'^([^,]+),\s*(.+)$', r'\2 \1')) AS `Manager 2 Name`,
  CAST(t.srmgremid AS STRING) AS `Senior Manager ID`,
  TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(t.srmanager, '')), r'^([^,]+),\s*(.+)$', r'\2 \1')) AS `Senior Manager Name`,

  -- Workgroup hierarchy
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.team, '')) AS `Team`,
  CAST(t.wgid AS STRING) AS `Workgroup ID`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.workgroup, '')) AS `Workgroup`,
  CAST(t.parentwgid AS STRING) AS `Parent Workgroup ID`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.parentworkgroup, '')) AS `Parent Workgroup`,
  CAST(t.grandparentwgid AS STRING) AS `Grandparent Workgroup ID`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.grandparentparentworkgroup, '')) AS `Grandparent Workgroup`,

  -- Site / geography
  CAST(t.siteid AS STRING) AS `Site ID`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.site, '')) AS `Site`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.typeofsite, '')) AS `Site Type`,
  CAST(t.virtualflag AS STRING) AS `Virtual Flag`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.subentity, '')) AS `Subentity`,
  CAST(t.regionid AS STRING) AS `Region ID`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.region, '')) AS `Region`,

  -- Skill / ranking attributes
  CAST(t.currentskilllevel AS STRING) AS `Current Skill Level`,
  TRIM(COALESCE(t.majorityskill, '')) AS `Majority Skill`,
  CAST(t.skillranking AS STRING) AS `Skill Ranking`,
  CAST(t.overallranking AS STRING) AS `Overall Ranking`,
  CAST(t.topxpercent AS STRING) AS `Top X Percent`,
  CAST(SAFE_CAST(t.skill_1_start_date AS DATE) AS STRING) AS `Skill 1 Start Date`,
  CAST(SAFE_CAST(t.skill_2_start_date AS DATE) AS STRING) AS `Skill 2 Start Date`,
  CAST(SAFE_CAST(t.skill_3_start_date AS DATE) AS STRING) AS `Skill 3 Start Date`,

  -- Record metadata
  CAST(t.styid AS STRING) AS `Style ID`,
  CAST(t.swapid AS STRING) AS `Swap ID`,
  CAST(SAFE_CAST(t.lastrundate AS DATE) AS STRING) AS `Last Run Date`,
  CAST(s.snapshot_date AS STRING) AS `Snapshot Date`,
  FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'America/Phoenix') AS `Refreshed At Arizona`
FROM `wf-gcp-us-ae-cs-prod.cs_reporting.tbl_customer_service_employee_performance_manager` AS t
CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot AS s
WHERE t.datetype = 'Day'
  AND t.date = s.snapshot_date
  AND t.stillatwayfair IS TRUE
  AND t.emid IS NOT NULL
-- One row per employee even if the source carries multiple TimePeriod rows per day
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.emid ORDER BY t.lastrundate DESC, t.mgremid) = 1
ORDER BY `Senior Manager Name`, `Manager Name`, `Employee Name`

parameters.content:
## Org Browser Full Roster - Weekly Monday 4AM Arizona

Standalone. Does not touch the TM PDP/ROD/PIP workflow. No documents generated, no emails sent.

### What it writes
Every ACTIVE Customer Service employee (agents) as one row, with the full management chain (Manager / Manager 2 / Senior Manager), workgroup hierarchy, site, region, and skill attributes. The previous version of this workflow used SELECT DISTINCT on manager fields only, which collapsed agents out of the result.

Source: `wf-gcp-us-ae-cs-prod.cs_reporting.tbl_customer_service_employee_performance_manager` (employee/day level, so no join needed).

### Schedule
Workflow timezone is set to `America/Phoenix`, cron `0 4 * * 1`. Arizona does not observe DST, so this is 11:00 UTC year-round. CONFIRM the timezone in Workflow Settings after import - if the instance default overrides it, the run will drift.

### Safety
If BigQuery returns zero rows the sheet is NOT cleared and the run fails loudly, so a bad query can never blank the directory.

The query takes the most recent daily snapshot in the last 7 days rather than hard-coding yesterday, so a missing Sunday snapshot does not produce an empty Monday run.

### To change the destination
Spreadsheet ID and tab name appear in 4 places: the two HTTP Request node URLs, `TAB_NAME` in Code - Build Sheets Write Chunks, and the summary in Code - Refresh Complete.

### After import
Select your BigQuery and Google Sheets OAuth credentials on the three credentialed nodes, run manually once, then activate.
